description: Known-good wire representations for SOIL messages, shared between all SOIL core implementations.
notes: Value-type wire names are lowercase ('null', 'integer', 'double', 'string', 'data', 'path', 'list', 'map'); note NONE is 'null' on the wire.

cases.name: none_value
cases.description: DATA, single root sample, NONE value ('null' on the wire)

cases.name: integer_value
cases.description: DATA, single root sample, INTEGER 42 (zigzag 84)

cases.name: double_value
cases.description: DATA, single root sample, DOUBLE 2.5 (big-endian IEEE 754)

cases.name: string_value_unicode
cases.description: DATA, single root sample, STRING with non-ASCII characters (UTF-8 length-prefixed)

cases.name: data_value
cases.description: DATA, single root sample, DATA bytes 00 01 02 fe (length-prefixed raw bytes)

cases.name: path_value
cases.description: DATA, single root sample, PATH value with two segments (count + length-prefixed strings)

cases.name: list_value
cases.description: DATA, single root sample, LIST of typed values (count + [type byte, value] each)

cases.name: map_value
cases.description: DATA, single root sample, MAP (count + [key string, typed value] each)

cases.name: nested_map_of_list
cases.description: DATA, single root sample, MAP whose value is a LIST of INTEGER

cases.name: empty_list
cases.description: DATA, single root sample, empty LIST

cases.name: empty_map
cases.description: DATA, single root sample, empty MAP

cases.name: single_sample_with_timestamp
cases.description: DATA, single root sample, sample timestamp 123.5 (sample header bit 7 set, then big-endian double)

cases.name: multiple_samples
cases.description: DATA, two samples with timestamps (tree header sample count 2)

cases.name: tree_with_children
cases.description: DATA, root sample plus one named child sample (tree header nibbles: 1 child, 1 sample)

cases.name: message_with_path
cases.description: DATA with a two-segment message path (top-level path as chain of 0x10 tree headers) and one root sample

cases.name: root_sample_with_message_time
cases.description: DATA with samples and message-level time. KNOWN LOSS: binary drops the message time (DATA carries no time field)

cases.name: message_time_end_id
cases.description: DATA without samples, message-level time, end and id. KNOWN LOSS: binary keeps only the id (7), drops time and end

cases.name: request_with_depth_zero
cases.description: REQUEST (binary type 1) with depth 0: indicator bit set plus explicit zero varint byte - falsy-but-legitimate value must survive

cases.name: deletion
cases.description: DELETION (binary type 2) for path 'old'

cases.name: subscription_inclusion
cases.description: SUBSCRIPTION_INCLUSION (binary type 3) for path 'tm'

cases.name: subscription_exclusion
cases.description: SUBSCRIPTION_EXCLUSION (binary type 4) for path 'tm/demo'

cases.name: subscription_deletion
cases.description: SUBSCRIPTION_DELETION (binary type 5) for path 'tm'

cases.name: count_only
cases.description: DATA with no path and no samples, count 5 (count indicator bit + varint)
